sentences.en: Do you believe that elephants can contemplate life after death?
sentences.zh: 你认为大象会在死后思考生命吗？

sentences.en: He is contemplating whether or not to buy the book.
sentences.zh: 他在考虑是否要买这本书。

sentences.en: Contemplating the reason for existence means contemplating non-existing things.
sentences.zh: 思考存在的意义就是思考不存在的事物。
